acceptance: Each listed job has a recorded disposition (covered by, ported to, or dropped because) in the dlv2-70 parity table.
Every job marked for porting is ported or has its own item in dlv2-70's needs.
context: Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review. Related: cross-surface-mutation-sensitivity-not-enforced-20261009, nightly-v2-throughput-uat-port-20261009, ruleset-drift-check-home-20261009.
description:
dlv2-70 requires job-level parity for each deleted workflow, but only liveness, Windows unit tests, throughput-uat and ruleset drift have port items. These nightly.yml jobs have no nightly-v2 equivalent and no item: duckdb-preview, slow-tier-observation (the only place the full cross-surface mutation-sensitivity tests run), sqlglot-generator, pyspark-tests, check-test-patterns, integration-smoke (including the Windows leg), integration-table-formats, postgres-integration, test-package, security, parity, green-unmerged-sweep, and the Windows Python 3.11 test leg. website-audit is deleted by site-split-50.

For each job, record either the nightly-v2 (or ci.yml/trunk.yml) job that now covers it, a port, or a dated reason to drop it.
